For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for warehouse employees! You make sure that orders are carefully collected, packed, and shipped. If you perform well, there is a chance of being taken over by the company. Read on quickly!

As a warehouse employee, you make sure that orders are processed neatly and on time. You work at the picking line and are responsible for collecting, scanning, checking, and preparing products for shipment.
